messages:
Samira K: Hi @people-ops, confidentially flagging an ongoing issue: a neighboring teammate has been wearing very strong cologne for several weeks. It gives me respiratory irritation and has made concentrating on code reviews and customer calls harder. I missed a deliverable yesterday because I needed to step out. I'm worried this could show up in my quarterly review. Can we request seating relocation, a short fragrance advisory to nearby desks, and an exclusion for any missed metrics tied to this week? Please keep details private.

Tess (People Ops): Thanks for letting us know, Samira 100% we can help and keep it confidential. Quick options we can move fast on: 1) low-visibility desk move to a different zone, 2) HEPA/air purifier at your desk, 3) trial WFH day for severe flare days, 4) a brief neighbor advisory about fragrance sensitivity (redacted). I will DM you the intake form and open a case if that works.

Samira K: DM received, filling it out now. Prefer desk move + purifier first. If the irritation continues, I'll take a WFH day. Also yes please exclude any productivity metrics for the affected days.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case created: AC-2026-5234. Tess assigned.

Rafael (Manager): Samira 1 I support this accommodation. I can cover your customer call tomorrow and will mark the missed deliverable as "blocked by environmental issue" so it doesn't harm your review. Please let People Ops coordinate with Facilities.

Omar (Facilities): We have Desk C-03 in the adjacent wing with lower foot traffic; I can reserve that and deliver a small HEPA unit by end of day. Do you want a private neighbor advisory saying "temporary seating and environment accommodation approved" without medical details?

Tess (People Ops): DM sent: https://redwood.hr/accom-intake (private). Process overview: employee fills short intake (you can redact reason), People Ops proposes interim accommodations (often same day), manager acknowledgement, Facilities executes low-visibility moves/equipment, case logged confidentially. We'll redact health details in any manager/facilities notes.

Samira K: Done. Please proceed with Desk C-03 + HEPA. Yes on the redacted advisory. Thank you.

Rafael (Manager): Confirmed. I've updated the team's schedule to cover your customer call and marked related KPIs for exclusion for the affected days. No further details shared.

Omar (Facilities): Desk C-03 reserved and HEPA unit scheduled for delivery at 5pm. We'll do a quick seat swap with minimal calendar noise.

Tess (People Ops): Case AC-2026-5234 updated: accommodations approved = Desk C-03, HEPA purifier, temporary WFH available. Manager notification sent (redacted). We'll check in in 5 business days to reassess.

Samira K: Really appreciate the swift, private help. This eases a lot of stress.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: follow-up check-in in 5 business days for case AC-2026-5234.
